comment: Timed clairvoyance (allmain.c seer_turn; a Wizard's cornuthaum makes him Clairvoyant) while engulfed. do_vicinity_map() marks the hero's square IN_SIGHT so the engulfer shows, and its 'You sense your surroundings.' pline runs vision_recalc(), which swaps gv.viz_array, because the lit lamp left on the floor makes movemon() set vision_full_recalc every turn. C then restores viz_array[u.uy][u.ux] in the live bitmap, so the engulfer is unseen again. The very next command is a melee hit with a +5 dwarvish mattock, before any further vision_recalc(); hmon_hitmon_msg_hit() then ends 'You hit the ochre jelly' with '.' because canseemon() is false, though the damage is above exclam()'s 4. Independent seed, date and character; #levelchange keeps the hero alive inside the jelly.
